goal: Establish what the camon Python package does and how it connects to the TypeScript and Kotlin parts of the insrc repository.

tasks.rationale: List every source-holding directory under camon/ so the package's internal layout is known before describing what it does.
Find camon's entrypoints (camon/src/camon/__main__.py was a low-score candidate) to see how the package is started and what commands it offers.
Walk the dependency tree rooted at camon/ to show how its internal modules depend on each other and on anything outside camon.
Extract the full functional surface of the camon Python package source (camon/src/camon) — the main evidence for what camon does.
Shallow surface of the whole camon/ directory to catch tests, scripts and config that sit outside camon/src/camon.
Shallow repo-root dependency tree to look for edges between camon and src, jetbrains-plugin, vscode-plugin and scripts; the bundle found none.
Enumerate repo-wide entrypoints so camon's entrypoints can be placed beside the daemon, MCP, CLI and plugin entrypoints.
Shallow surface of the TypeScript src/ tree to find any place that spawns, calls or shares a contract with camon.
Shallow surface of the Kotlin jetbrains-plugin to check whether it references camon or only the daemon gateway.
Shallow surface of vscode-plugin to check for any link to camon; the bundle had no live detail on this directory.
Shallow surface of scripts/ since build or launch scripts are a likely place where camon is invoked from the rest of the repo.
Stitch camon's layout, entrypoints, dependency trees and the surfaces of the other parts into one answer on camon's role and links.

reasoning: The bundle profiled only the repo root and says almost nothing about camon, so the plan first maps camon itself (modules, entrypoints, dependency tree, deep surface of camon/src/camon plus a shallow pass over the whole directory). It then looks for links to the rest of the repo: a shallow repo-root dependency tree, repo-wide entrypoints, and shallow surfaces of src, jetbrains-plugin, vscode-plugin and scripts. Omitted: design, docs and site (no code surface), adherence checks (no constraints given), and further recursive deep-dives, since this is already a child plan.
